title: Heartbeat answer (router to agent, binary frame HBACK, stream 0)
description: The router's verdict after each HB. The agent shows it in its status (/healthz is healthy while an answer arrived within three intervals, at least 30 s). An unapproved identity gets state pending. A heartbeat the router could not apply gets state empty and error.

state.description: The router's node state: free, busy or offline; pending before approval; empty when the heartbeat could not be applied.

busy_reason.description: Why the router counts the node as busy, for display only.

gpu_guard_ack.description: true: the router respects this node's GPU guard (global setting and node policy). Absent before approval.

error.description: Why the heartbeat could not be applied, for logs only.
